errors.message: Failing call: the post-IMPLEMENT method import smoke test in env `method_CANDI` (`python -c "import EasyTSAD.Controller"`, recorded at EasyTSAD/Harness/tasks/CANDI/journal.jsonl:75) exits with `FAIL   CANDI` on `EasyTSAD/Plots/plot.py:3  from matplotlib import pyplot as plt` -> `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'matplotlib'`. Nothing in CANDI runs; the failure is upstream of method code. Cause: the method-local venv EasyTSAD/Methods/CANDI/environment/.venv is still a truncated/partial materialization, not a missing declaration. `matplotlib>=3.7.5` IS declared in EasyTSAD/Methods/CANDI/environment/pyproject.toml:65 and is required by the EasyTSAD core chain EasyTSAD/Controller/TSADController.py:10 -> EasyTSAD/Plots/__init__.py:1 -> EasyTSAD/Plots/plot.py:3, yet site-packages contains only `matplotlib-3.11.2.dist-info/` (LICENSE, METADATA, WHEEL, RECORD) and no `matplotlib/` package directory; the same truncation remains for `yacs/`, which holds only config.py and tests.py with no `__init__.py` (that is the exact file the earlier aborted `uv sync` failed to hardlink: `Disk quota exceeded (os error 122)` at journal.jsonl:39). So the env install silently half-completed and each subsequent run inherits the broken venv. Method-local repair in EasyTSAD/Methods/CANDI/environment: delete the partial `.venv` and re-run `uv sync --project EasyTSAD/Methods/CANDI/environment` to completion with the recorded mitigations (dedicated `[tool.uv] cache-dir` on scratch storage, `link-mode = "copy"`, `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT` pointing at the method-local `.venv`, >= 6 GiB free or `uv cache clean`), then verify `python -c "import matplotlib, yacs, torch, scipy, sklearn, pandas"` and re-run the `import EasyTSAD.Controller` smoke test before the next run. No implementation files were edited and no test-set performance was used.
